choice:60:0:1.female: I trust the dragon more than you.

say:2:1410908001:1.text: That sound! It's the dragon... It's flying away!

say:4:1410908002:1.text: It came from the square! I need to see what's happening!
say:4:1410908002:1.source_cn: 声音从广场那边传来！我得去看看……

say:5:1410908003:1.text: With the queen dead, the statue she held together with magic would've shattered. Sal'thorin will be plunged into chaos after the citizens see that.
say:5:1410908003:1.source_cn: 女王一旦崩逝，她用魔力维系的女王雕像也会随之破碎，萨洛...

say:6:1410908004:1.text: I understand, Indris, but you just killed her... It's too dangerous to go there now!
say:6:1410908004:1.source_cn: 因度厄！你的意思我懂，但你刚刚杀了……这时候过去也太危险了！

say:7:1410908005:1.text: That's why I need to go there even more.

say:8:1410908006:1.text: The guards need to maintain order and calm the people.
say:8:1410908006:1.source_cn: 卫队需要维持秩序，安抚民众。哪怕……

say:9:1410908007:1.text: Stop being so stubborn! What if you get caught when you get there?!
say:9:1410908007:1.source_cn: 你这个死脑筋！现在过去要是被抓了可怎么办！

say:10:1410908008:1.text: I am Indris, Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard. Before I'm relieved of my duties...
say:10:1410908008:1.source_cn: 我是因度厄，萨洛克兰的卫队长。在我的职务尚未被解除之前——

say:11:1410908009:1.text: ...I'll never hide when the people need me, not when it matters the most!
say:11:1410908009:1.source_cn: 我绝不会在民众最需要的时候躲藏！

choice_prompt:12:1410908009.text: ...I'll never hide when the people need me, not when it matters the most!
choice_prompt:12:1410908009.source_cn: 我绝不会在民众最需要的时候躲藏！

say:13:1410908010:1.text: Ha! I can't believe he said that with a straight face. It sounded pretty cool though... Alright, I'm in!
say:13:1410908010:1.source_cn: 哇……你都这么说了，我们还能怎么办？好吧，加我一个！
say:13:1410908010:1.male: Ha! I can't believe he said that with a straight face. It sounded pretty cool though... Alright, I'm in!
say:13:1410908010:1.female: Ha! I can't believe he said that with a straight face. It sounded pretty cool though... Alright, I'm in!

say:14:1410908011:1.text: But if the situation turns on us, we make a run for it!
say:14:1410908011:1.source_cn: 情况不妙的话，要赶快溜哦！

say:3:1410916001:0.text: Your Highness, how's the situation here? Do you need my help?
say:3:1410916001:0.source_cn: 殿下，这边的情况怎么样了？需要我帮忙吗？

say:4:1410916002:0.text: Oh, Indris, you came just in time, and all your limbs seem to be intact.
say:4:1410916002:0.source_cn: 啊……因度厄，来得正好。你那张脸似乎没破相，更好了。

say:5:1410916003:0.text: I just managed to calm some people down.
say:5:1410916003:0.source_cn: 刚才，我好不容易稍稍安抚了慌乱的民众。

say:6:1410916004:0.text: And then you, the one who orchestrated this disaster, come running along, offering me aid. Your timing is impeccable.
say:6:1410916004:0.source_cn: 紧接着，你这个始作俑者就如此亲密地出现在我身边搭话要帮...

say:7:1410916005:0.text: I'm happy to help, Your Highness.

choice_prompt:8:1410916005.text: I'm happy to help, Your Highness.

say:9:1410916006:0.text: ... Your Highness, I have no intention of causing trouble. Please don't misunderstand.
say:9:1410916006:0.source_cn: ……殿下，您误会了，我并没有来捣乱的意思。

say:10:1410916007:0.text: Calm yourself. You're still the same—devoid of humor and utterly unskilled in deception.
say:10:1410916007:0.source_cn: 别这么紧张，你还是老样子，既不懂幽默，也不懂说谎。

say:11:1410916008:0.text: Since you did not deny that you orchestrated this disaster, please explain to me what happened.
say:11:1410916008:0.source_cn: 既然你没有否认自己始作俑者的身份，想必你可以为我解释一...

choice_prompt:12:1410916008.text: Since you did not deny that you orchestrated this disaster, please explain to me what happened.
choice_prompt:12:1410916008.source_cn: 既然你没有否认自己始作俑者的身份，想必你可以为我解释一下到底发生了什么吧？

say:13:1410916009:0.text: We defeated Velara... and your mother, Queen Seralyth. There is no need for further panic, citizens!
say:13:1410916009:0.source_cn: 我们最后击败了奎茵……与您的母亲奈萨雷斯。

say:15:1410916011:1.text: The Primordial Dragon seemed to have sensed that we had kept our oath and flew away.
say:15:1410916011:1.source_cn: 初始之龙似乎能感应到我们遵守了承诺，然后飞离了此地。

say:16:1410916012:0.text: Also, if we use the Sylvan Tendril properly, there should be a way to completely remove our curse. <style="stress"><player_name></style> is willing to help us. We should all stay calm.
say:16:1410916012:0.source_cn: 但别太担心，只要好好使用织叶，应该有办法彻底解除我们的...
say:16:1410916012:0.male: Also, if we use the Sylvan Tendril properly, there should be a way to completely remove our curse. <style="stress"><player_name></style> is willing to help us. We should all stay calm.
say:16:1410916012:0.female: Also, if we use the Sylvan Tendril properly, there should be a way to completely remove our curse. <style="stress"><player_name></style> is willing to help us. We should all stay calm.

say:19:1410916015:0.text: No cheers or celebration... Are you disappointed?
say:19:1410916015:0.source_cn: 没有听到欢呼和赞美，很失望？

say:21:1410916017:0.text: Look... After listening to your little speech, no one's panicking anymore. This is already impressive.
say:21:1410916017:0.source_cn: 看，听了你那么惊天动地的一段发言，大家居然还都秩序井然...

say:22:1410916018:0.text: However, in a sense, we have Velara to thank for this. Arresting the troublemakers from the last riot probably helped keep things in check.
say:22:1410916018:0.source_cn: 某种意义上说，多亏奎茵冕下此前“治理有方”，上次处刑时...

say:23:1410916019:0.text: These people are still afraid. Whether commoners, nobles, or priests, none dare to act rashly. For now, order still holds—it's not yet reached the point of no return.
say:23:1410916019:0.source_cn: 这些人心有余悸，无论是平民、贵族还是祭司，都不敢轻举妄...

say:24:1410916020:0.text: Oh, I hope you haven't forgotten that execution, Indris?
say:24:1410916020:0.source_cn: 啊，我想你该不会忘记那次处刑吧，因度厄？

say:25:1410916021:0.source_cn: 我怎么会忘记！！斐利尔他……

say:26:1410916022:0.text: Therefore, if you truly wish to liberate the people, maintaining order here is meaningless.
say:26:1410916022:0.source_cn: 所以，如果想要解放民众的话，在这里维持秩序也没有意义了。

say:27:1410916023:0.text: If you truly want to erase everything the queen stood for, why not just reduce Sal'thorin to ashes and be done with it?
say:27:1410916023:0.source_cn: 如果想要推翻女王的一切，那么干脆彻底把萨洛克兰推入火海...

say:28:1410916024:0.text: I cannot do that! There are innocent lives here!
say:28:1410916024:0.source_cn: 当然不可能！还有那么多无辜的人——

say:29:1410916025:0.text: <style="highlight">Innocent</style>... Tell me, who do you think is actually innocent?

say:30:1410916026:0.text: Was Feli innocent? Was Velara? Am I innocent?
say:30:1410916026:0.source_cn: 斐利尔无辜吗？奎茵无辜吗？我无辜吗？

say:31:1410916027:0.text: You've hunted, condemned, and led countless to their deaths. And now, you've undone everything yourself, leaving Sal'thorin in ruins. So, Indris, are you innocent?
say:31:1410916027:0.source_cn: 追捕了那么多无辜者，将他们逼入死路，如今又亲手颠覆这一...

say:32:1410916028:0.text: I... I will take responsibility and atone for my sins.
say:32:1410916028:0.source_cn: ……我……会承担责任，也会赎清自己的罪行……

say:33:1410916029:0.text: Even you think these words are too soft, don't you? That's why they're so hard to say.
say:33:1410916029:0.source_cn: 连你自己也觉得这样的说法太苍白了，所以难以启齿吧？

say:34:1410916030:0.text: There should be freedom, but not too much freedom. There should be order, but it can't be too strict.
say:34:1410916030:0.source_cn: 想要自由，又不想要太彻底的自由；想要秩序，又不想要太森...

say:35:1410916031:0.text: So, now you draw the boundaries, set the standards, and interpret the rules. Is this what you want, Indris?
say:35:1410916031:0.source_cn: 边界由你划分，标准由你制定，规则由你解释——因度厄，这...

say:36:1410916032:0.text: Because to me, this is a power far greater than the rule that came before.
say:36:1410916032:0.source_cn: 要我说，这可是比此前的统治更加强大的权力哦。

say:37:1410916033:0.text: Oh, by the way, <style="highlight">Thador seems to have left Sal'thorin</style>, which means I am the sole Exarch remaining.

say:38:1410916034:0.text: But leadership is a burden I've no desire to carry. I'd rather abdicate and have someone else rule more wisely.
say:38:1410916034:0.source_cn: 但率领和统治太麻烦了，我宁愿退位让贤——

say:39:1410916035:0.text: Ah, my dear spectators, rejoice! You are about to embrace a tyrant even more delightfully unpredictable than my esteemed mother.
say:39:1410916035:0.source_cn: 嘿——看戏的朋友们，恭喜，你们要迎来一位比我尊贵的母亲...

say:40:1410916036:0.text: This is not what I want! I just wanted to expose the lies and bring true freedom to all!
say:40:1410916036:0.source_cn: 这不是我想要的！我只想揭穿谎言，为大家带来自由——

say:41:1410916037:0.text: To be blunt, the panic and chaos you've incited during this period surpasses anything that has come before. A remarkable achievement, if I may say so.
say:41:1410916037:0.source_cn: 但客观而言，你这段时间带来的恐慌和混乱，远远超出过往的...

choice_prompt:42:1410916037.text: To be blunt, the panic and chaos you've incited during this period surpasses anything that has come before. A remarkable achievement, if I may say so.
choice_prompt:42:1410916037.source_cn: 但客观而言，你这段时间带来的恐慌和混乱，远远超出过往的总和了。

say:43:1410916038:0.text: I don't want to defend my mother. You see, good intentions, however pure, rarely lead to the results one hopes for.
say:43:1410916038:0.source_cn: 我不想为我的母亲辩解，很多时候，好的动机，并不代表能有...

say:44:1410916039:0.text: At first, it was all about soothing the masses, wasn't it? My mother and the sage Tasso, just trying to ease anxiety and despair. But oh, once they tasted the sweetness of power... Well, who could resist holding onto it?
say:44:1410916039:0.source_cn: 她和塔萨贤者在一开始，也只是想要让人们从惶惶不安中平静...

say:45:1410916040:0.text: However, the truth is undeniable. The perverse order of Sal'thorin is real. The fanaticism, the corrupt transformations—these are facts. And our long history of living in darkness is something we can't hide from any longer.
say:45:1410916040:0.source_cn: 但萨洛克兰扭曲的秩序是事实，疯狂的精神与孽化的躯体是事...

say:46:1410916041:0.text: When compared to their motives, these are the undeniable facts—consequences they must bear. Your rebellion, too, is a direct result of their past decisions.
say:46:1410916041:0.source_cn: 比起那些难以捉摸的动机，这些事实，才是他们必须要承担的...

say:47:1410916042:0.text: I understand. At this crossroads, the responsibility of making the choice falls to me.
say:47:1410916042:0.source_cn: 我明白您的意思了。现在，走在路口，将要做出选择的人，是我。

say:48:1410916043:0.text: I've shouted enough. It's time to stop talking and start doing something that actually matters.
say:48:1410916043:0.source_cn: 比起继续高喊口号，现在的我，应该开始真正地做点什么。

say:49:1410916044:0.text: Since you're not going to hand in your resignation, I have another task for you.
say:49:1410916044:0.source_cn: 那么，既然你还不打算向我递交辞呈，我就再派给你一个任务吧。

say:50:1410916045:0.text: I order you to go to the surface and see for yourself what it's like.
say:50:1410916045:0.source_cn: 我命令你——去地表看看，看看那究竟是怎样的地方。

say:51:1410916046:0.text: I'm sure the surface is full of beautiful things—though I imagine there are just as many lies and ugly truths lurking beneath, much like in Sal'thorin.
say:51:1410916046:0.source_cn: 那里一定有很多美好的东西，也一定会有很多谎言和丑恶……...

say:52:1410916047:0.text: However, there must be something different about the surface compared to Sal'thorin. I'll maintain order here while you're there.
say:52:1410916047:0.source_cn: 但一定，也有与萨洛克兰不一样的地方。这里的秩序由我维护...

say:53:1410916048:0.text: Upon your return, report precisely what you saw and heard—whether it was good, bad, or simply different. The truth must be told.
say:53:1410916048:0.source_cn: 回来后，要把你的见闻原原本本地告诉我们——无论是好的，...

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: （共同讲述了救出因度厄的后续）

say:0:1410918001:0.text: Is this the sun...? It's brighter than the shine of gold... and so warm.
say:0:1410918001:0.source_cn: 这就是太阳吗……比黄金还更加璀璨的光辉，如此温暖。

say:1:1410919001:0.text: The water... It's so refreshing. The burning in my throat is gone...
say:1:1410919001:0.source_cn: 水……又咸又苦，但它又是如此清凉，喉咙的烧灼感立刻消失了。

say:0:1410920001:0.text: Are these flowers of the surface? It feels as if their very life is calling to me...
say:0:1410920001:0.source_cn: 这是地表的花吗……它的生命仿佛在呼唤着我……

subtitle:1:1410904101:.text: Blood and soul, surrender to the darkness.
subtitle:1:1410904101:.source_cn: 血与灵，献予黑暗之潮汐

subtitle:1:1410904102:.text: Let the cold embrace of eternity cover this place...
subtitle:1:1410904102:.source_cn: 让永恒的寒意笼罩于此……

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410904201:.text: She wants to take us down with her!

subtitle:1:1411093003:.text: It is not divine. You know that.
subtitle:1:1411093003:.source_cn: 这不是恩典，你明明知道——

subtitle:1:1411093007:.text: To surrender all to the Queen's will—

subtitle:1:1411094009:.text: more than they ever hated me.

subtitle:1:1411094011:.text: Shall await you in the abyss!
